fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]I hope you had an enjoyable flight, and we’ll see you again real soon!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Oh, by the way.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Each of the bells are in their own key and ring out a specific jingle that helps me figure out where you are! See, sounds echo quite aimlessly up in the sky, so this helps speed up the process!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]I only offer pick up and drop off at the designated perches! It’s all part of the terms and services! (also apparently emergency rescue services…)

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Finally, by riding Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom you accept any and all accidental damages that can happen and may result in permanent damage, and or death!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Though, that’s yet to happen. *wink*

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]OK With that all out of the way, where would you like to go?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Sure!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Ok here goes! *Ahem*

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Welcome to Penny Plume’s, Ride and Zoom!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]The name’s Penny, as you know, and I’ll be your flight attendant today!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]… And every other day. I’m the only one who works at Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Let me explain how it works! I’ve given these bells to everyone in the forest, and when a critter needs a ride, they can ring the bell and I’ll pick them up!
